  - 0.1
  weight: 0.3
- id: reach_goal
  weight: 0.7
phases:
- id: approach_1

  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_object
    entity: push_box
    offset:

    - 0.0
    - 0.1
    tolerance: 0.01
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
  parameters:

      - path: target.offset.z

  parameters:
    push_speed:
      type: scalar
      range:

skill: push_to_goal
dsl_version: 2
subtasks:
- id: reach_pre_contact
  anchor: object
  offset:
  - 0.0
  - 0.0
  - 0.03
  weight: 0.3
- id: reach_goal
  weight: 0.7
phases:
- id: approach_to_behind
  type: approach
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: task_object
    entity: push_box
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.03
    offset_along_axis:
      distance: 0.07
      axis: task_goal_direction
      mode: add_to_offset
      sign: negative
    tolerance: 0.02
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
  parameters:
    approach_height:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.02
      - 0.08
      default: 0.03
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset.z
        mode: replace
    behind_distance:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.02
      - 0.15
      default: 0.07
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset_along_axis.distance
        mode: replace
    speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.02
      - 0.1
      default: 0.05
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: replace
  subtask_id: reach_pre_contact
- id: push_toward_goal
  type: push
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: impedance_control
  termination: pose_tolerance
  target:
    source: yaml
    anchor: current_tcp
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    offset_along_axis:
      distance: 0.25
      axis: task_goal_direction
      mode: add_to_offset
      sign: positive
    tolerance: 0.02
    orientation:
      mode: keep_current
  parameters:
    push_distance:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.1
      - 0.4
      default: 0.25
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset_along_axis.distance
        mode: replace
    push_speed:
      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.01
      - 0.1
      default: 0.03
      binds_to:
      - path: generator.speed
        mode: replace

  - id: contact_made
    when: during_phase
    predicate: contact_detected
    threshold: 1.0
    on_failure: retry
  retries:
    max_attempts: 2
    strategy: reduce_speed
    offset:
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
    - 0.0
  subtask_id: reach_goal
- id: retract_clear
  type: retract
  generator: linear_cartesian
  control: position_control
  termination: pose_tolerance

    source: yaml

      mode: keep_current
  parameters:
    retract_height:

      default: 0.1
      binds_to:
      - path: target.offset.z
        mode: replace

      type: scalar
      range:
      - 0.01
      - 0.1
      default: 0.05

      - path: generator.speed
